# Qiskit Fermions

> Qiskit Fermions extends Qiskit with tools for working with fermionic systems: operator data structures, a framework and library for converting operators between representations and to qubit operators (for example the Jordan-Wigner encoding), and a framework and library for synthesizing fermionic quantum circuits. The core is written in Rust and exposed through first-party Python and C APIs.


2026, Qiskit addons team

- [givens_decomposition](qiskit_fermions.linalg.givens_decomposition.html.md): Decomposes a unitary matrix into Givens rotations and diagonal phases.
- [givens_decomposition_slater](qiskit_fermions.linalg.givens_decomposition_slater.html.md): Decomposes the occupied orbitals of a Slater determinant into Givens rotations.
- [SupportsApplyUnitaryPlaced](qiskit_fermions.protocols.SupportsApplyUnitaryPlaced.html.md): A package-specific extension of &#96;ffsim.SupportsApplyUnitary&#96;.
- [SupportsCommutators](qiskit_fermions.protocols.SupportsCommutators.html.md): A Protocol indicating support for efficient commutator generation.
- [SupportsFermionOperator](qiskit_fermions.protocols.SupportsFermionOperator.html.md): This package’s operator-conversion contract, converting an operator to a &#96;FermionOperator&#96;.
- [SupportsMajoranaOperator](qiskit_fermions.protocols.SupportsMajoranaOperator.html.md): An equivalent of the &#96;SupportsFermionOperator&#96; protocol, targeting Majorana operators.
